notes: LG Business Solutions IP camera manuals (LNB/LND/LNU/LNV/LNP series) are available on lg.com/global/business and gscs-b2c.lge.com but are all scanned image-based PDFs (Adobe Illustrator/Photoshop exports) with no machine-readable text. No RTSP URL path could be extracted from any official LG document. Third-party aggregators (iSpyConnect, security.world) cite paths such as /video1+audio1 for the LG 7210R, but these are community-sourced and do not meet the official-documentation requirement.
